BiblicalUsage: Amzi appears twice, both times in lists: once as a Levite in the genealogy of the singers — the son of Bani, the son of Shamer — and once as an ancestor of Adaiah, one of the priests who did the work of the house in Jerusalem after the exile. The two mentions may be the same man or two men of the same name; the Bible gives us only the lists.
TheologicalSignificance: Two list entries are all we have of Amzi, and I believe that is enough: his family sang in the house of God and worked in it, and the lists remember them for it.
